# fyre_stencils (Data Source)

Fetches a list of Fyre stencils filtered by product group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `product_group_id` (Number) Product group ID to filter stencils. Defaults to provider's product_group_id if not specified.
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier
- `stencils` (Attributes List) List of stencils in the product group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stencils))

<a id="nestedatt--stencils"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stencils`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPUs
- `description` (String) Stencil description
- `disk` (Number) Disk size in GB
- `memory` (Number) Memory in GB
- `name` (String) Stencil name
- `os` (String) Operating system
- `owner` (Attributes) Stencil owner information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stencils--owner))
- `platform` (String) Platform type
- `product_group_id` (Number) Product group ID
- `stencil_ids` (List of String) List of stencil identifiers

<a id="nestedatt--stencils--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stencils.owner`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Owner email address
- `name` (String) Owner name
- `user_id` (Number) Owner user ID
- `username` (String) Owner username
